text:
Sam: FYI started a 4% canary for model v9-int4 on /generate targeting long-document-heavy routes (>2200 tokens). Initial quick-check shows factuality drift on that slice.
Tara: paste the deltas?
Sam: short dump:
```
long-doc (>2200):
  baseline(v8-fp16): factuality_fail=3.2%, mrr=0.861, p99=215ms
  v9-int4:           factuality_fail=5.9% (+2.7pp), mrr=0.849 (-0.012), p99=228ms (+13ms)
short-doc (<300): negligible diffs
compute: ~-19% token-cpu
```
Ibrahim: +2.7pp on long-doc crosses our 2.0pp guard. Are we on the standard eval harness?
Sam: yes same harness + human anchors. Severity mostly "major" for long-docs.
Miko: Any KV cache signal? quant paths often change eviction timing.
Sam: KV hit-rate: baseline 86.9% -> v9-int4 80.8% (-6.1pp).
Tara: that's large. Likely cache churn -> re-gen -> hallucination. GateBot, what's our auto-fallback rule?
GateBot: Auto-fallback ruleset: 1) core slice halluc/factuality delta >= 2.0pp -> immediate reroute; 2) relative MRR drop >= 1.0% -> hold and notify; 3) composite FallbackIndex >= 1.0 triggers auto-fallback.
Ibrahim: Suggest we compute FallbackIndex = max(halluc_delta/2.0, -factuality_delta/0.03, kv_hit_drop/4.0). For this run: 2.7/2=1.35, 0.027/0.03=0.9, 6.1/4=1.525 => FallbackIndex=1.525 (trips).
Sam: Proposed immediate actions: 1) throttle from 4% -> 1%; 2) pin long-doc slice to baseline v8-fp16; 3) enable shadowing for v9-int4 to collect full traces; 4) run seeded 100k long-doc eval with severity buckets; 5) spin a v9-fp16 build to isolate quant vs model-change.
Miko: Also add per-layer kv-eviction heatmap and tracking of attention-proj eviction spikes. If eviction concentrates on certain layers we can try per-layer mixed-quant (keep those layers fp16/int8).
Tara: I'll flip the route and bump the canary dashboard to expose FallbackIndex and kv_hit_drop as primary alarms. Add MRR smoothing window 10m to avoid transient flips.
Ibrahim: If fp16 aligns with baseline, plan B = per-layer mixed-quant (attn/proj in higher precision) followed by a targeted 1% canary.
GateBot: Canary change executed at 5101234575: traffic 4% -> 1%. Routing rule applied: long-doc cohort pinned to v8-fp16. Shadowing of v9-int4 remains enabled. Observability job "v9-longdoc-seed" scheduled.
Sam: thanks all. I'll post the seeded-run link when it finishes and tag kernel/infra if we need a runtime toggle. :eyes:
